sentences.text: Ajay Devgan -LRB- born Vishal Veeru Devgan on 2 April 1969 -RRB- , also credited as Ajay Devgn , is an Indian film actor , director and producer .	Veeru Devgan	Veeru Devgan
He is widely considered as one of the most popular actors of Hindi cinema , who has appeared in over a hundred Hindi films .	Hindi cinema	Hindi cinema	hundred Hindi films	Ajay Devgan filmography

Devgan has won numerous accolades , including two National Film Awards and four Filmfare Awards .	numerous accolades	List of awards and nominations received by Ajay Devgn	National Film Awards	National Film Awards	Filmfare Awards	Filmfare Awards

In 2016 , he was honoured by the Government of India with the Padma Shri , the fourth highest civilian honour of the country .	Padma Shri	Padma Shri	Government of India	Government of India	civilian honour	Indian honours system

Devgan began his professional career with Phool Aur Kaante in 1991 and received a Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut for his performance .	Phool Aur Kaante	Phool Aur Kaante	Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut	Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut

In 1999 , his most-talked-about film was Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam in which he played Vanraj , a man who tries to unite his wife with her lover .	Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam	Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam

In the early 2000s , he gave critically acclaimed performances in Ram Gopal Varma 's fictional expose of Mumbai underworld Company .	Ram Gopal Varma	Ram Gopal Varma	Mumbai underworld	Mumbai underworld	Company	Company (film)
He played the character of a gangster , for which he won Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor .	Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor	Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor

The same year he gave another critically acclaimed performance in Deewangee for which he received the Filmfare Best Villain Award .	Deewangee	Deewangee	Filmfare Best Villain Award	Filmfare Best Villain Award
